findings.issue: MEDIUM: on.push.paths omits modules/libs/authjwt/** and modules/libs/logging/**; a main push touching only those libs never starts the workflow, so no image is rebuilt (the job filters list them, but the trigger gates first).
findings.fix: Add both globs to on.push.paths, as done for modules/libs/catalogdb/**.

findings.issue: MEDIUM: forced catalog install renames current.db to the backup before copying the new snapshot; a failed copy leaves no catalog (confirmed by a red test kept out of tree). Pre-existing ordering carried into the new Store.
findings.fix: Copy to a temp file in the same dir, then back up and rename; or restore the backup on failure.

findings.issue: MEDIUM: with an open /sse stream, httpServer.Shutdown consumes the whole 30s grace; Pool.Wait then gets an expired ctx and the stores are closed under running workers.
findings.fix: Call the mcp-go SSE/streamable Shutdown first and give Pool.Wait its own grace context.

findings.issue: MEDIUM: library.db is now held open for the process lifetime; an external replace of the file leaves reads on the old inode and attribution writes on the deleted copy.
findings.fix: Reopen on inode/mtime change, or document restart-after-import.
